4644-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

892-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
892-4881-6909.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-5931-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-4826-5700-5701-7892.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-7892.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

813-2103-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-3151-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-4785.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-643-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-6797.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

4905-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2730-3175-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2191-4416-7186.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
2191-4416-7186.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Collective Inferno, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2350-4871-5496-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

2757-5864-7110-7111.notablePrerequisites: You control four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats
2757-5864-7110-7111.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat, untapping the basic Island.
Repeat from step 1 three additional times.
Cast Get Out by paying {U}{U}, targeting Stormchaser's Talent. Stormchaser's Talent's first ability, Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve the Stormchaser Talent trigger, creating a 1/1 Otter creature token with prowess.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Get Out, returning Stormchaser's Talent from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 once.
Cast Stormchaser's Talent by paying {U}. Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Stormchaser's Talent by paying {3}{U}, causing it to gain level 2. It then triggers, returning Get Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1385-2511-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

549-1978-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat

1947-2744-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-2744-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

618-3719-6486.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Enduring Courage with haste.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create a number of Treasure tokens equal to its power.
Activate a Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, both Enduring Courages trigger, giving Kiki-Jiki +4/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create a number of Treasure tokens equal to its power.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-2493-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Pinnacle Monk
When Archaeomancer and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1909-4486-5709.notablePrerequisites: Rofellos does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two Forests.
1909-4486-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat.
1909-4486-5709.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

719-5231-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-5231-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-5231-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Snail, adding {R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2536-5674.manaNeeded: {G} if you don't have an energy counter
2536-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have less than two energy counters.
2536-5674.description:
Cast Greenbelt Ramager by paying {E} if able, or {G} otherwise.
When Greenbelt Ramager enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

572-2825-4067-5126.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an opponent to discard a card.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control at least one mana-producing permanent.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
572-2825-4067-5126.description:
Cause an opponent to discard at least one card.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding Sandstorm Eidolon and another card, untapping Elite Arcanist and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream Salvage without paying its mana cost.
Sandstorm Eidolon triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Dream Salvage, causing you to draw at least one card.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3635-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Whirler Rogue.
1409-3635-4050.description:
Activate Whirler Rogue by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Whirler Rogue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Whirler Rogue trigger, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Whirler Rogue.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing both Thopters, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

893-1651-4772.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Myr tokens, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

1778-2034-4535-5224.description:
Cast Memnite.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Memnite.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Memnite dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Repeat.

478-757-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos and pay {1}, by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

855-2060-2854-4518.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
855-2060-2854-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Kor Skyfisher triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

38-1678-3284-5220.description:
Sacrifice Skirk Prospector to add {R}.
Put it on top of your library with Mortuary and proceed to draw it with Korvold.
Ping with Mayhem Devil.
With your floating mana, recast Skirk Prospector.

1112-2050-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Weirding Wood attached to a Forest you control.
1112-2050-4222.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Weirding Wood, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
